symptom: ako/mxcli#859 (rehearsal S8): under mdl 1 an identical re-run of a microflow whose retrieve has a nested XPath predicate (`where [A_B/B[Name = empty]]`) was refused: "its description cannot be compared: the description does not parse: no viable alternative at input '['"; under mdl 0 the flow was rebuilt (MDL-V1-REBUILD).
cause: describe prints a lone XPath group without its outer brackets as `where <expr>`, which the parser reads as an expression; an expression has no `[`, so a path step with a predicate made describe's output unparseable by its own parser.
fix: describe keeps the outer brackets when the group holds a `[` outside a string literal (xpathHasNestedPredicate, cmd_microflows_format_action.go). The PedApp/TestApp splice-parity property now fails, rather than logs, a refusal whose cause is an unparseable description.
insight: The splice parity property logged every refusal as acceptable, so a refusal caused by describe itself was invisible there; a property that tolerates a class of failure must still fail the sub-class that is the tool's own fault.
